paragraphs: R. Simai, Shabbat, Rabbi Akiva, 88a. A baraita: R. Simai asks the Torah's source for resurrection, beginning of Ḥelek. R. Elazar in R. Simai's name, Bereshit Rabbah, Vayera 48. Kohelet Rabbah, 'Send your bread upon the waters,' has R. Elazar son of R. Sima in the same matter. Rabbah, Naso 14, has R. Elazar son of R. Ḥayyim: a scribal error for R. Elazar in R. Simai's name. Kohelet Rabbah, 'A generation goes and a generation comes': Simaii. R. Ḥiyya in his name (see R. Ḥelbo). R. Ḥiyya bar Abba said: R. Simai said, Ḥelek 106a; Sotah 11a. R. Yonatan asked him. R. Yaakov bar Idi in his name. Rav Naḥman bar Ḥisda expounded R. Simai's testimony in Ḥaggai, Zekharyah and Malakhi's name, Rosh HaShanah 19b. He and R. Tzadok went to Lod to intercalate years and ruled like Rabbi on terefot concerning the crop.
